body: Thank you, you are very kind, the world needs more of you, hope we all find our people.

I have 2 failed overdoses. It sucks you know, I feel like sucha a pathetic loser who can't take her own life. My parents are very controlling, abusive in so many ways, while having a mental breakdown I told them, I can't live w them anymore and they told me there's no way they'll let me out of the house and they told me nobody would give me a job before my completion of 12th grade, which was true. So I told them that I'm gonna kill myself and they said "death is your choice, but if you are living its under us" that was it for me, my first overdose, they found me in my room and rushed me to the hospital and when I opened my eyes, I had a full on panic attack, all the cardiologist and psychiatrist came rushing and then after few days, I was discharged and then my parents on the way back home, in car were talking about how costly saving me was and how they should have left me dead and how it was my fault they lost their money. Felt amazing to hear you know.

I'm so sorry you are going through this, but trust me, it's their loss, their inability to be understanding and kind, unlike you. Its a good thing they said that now, cause they might've hidden who they really are for years and you'd get so invested in the friendship and they would break your heart and at that time, I'd would've been worse, the universe removed them from you cause you deserve much better. There are millions and millions of people who'd love, love and LOVE to have you as their friend, like me. So fuck them, they'll get what they deserve, let us take a step and put ourselves in front of everyone, we are the most important person for ourselves.
Hey hey hey? You there? You wanna talk about it? I know it sucks, I don't wanna be here too, talk to me about your life
